Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"

SPECIFICATION FOR 
CARTRIDGES FOR SHOT GUNS 

PART 5 ANVIL 



1. Scope — Covers the dimensional and material requirements of anvil for shot gun cartridges. 

2. Dimensions — Shall be as shown in Fig. 1.

IB FLAT ANVIL DE&IGN 

Note 1 — All sharp corners to be joined with curves. 
Note 2 — Anvils to pass through ring gauges of 4*547 diameter. 
Note 3 — Hardness of finished anvil to be not (ess than 140 VPN. 

All dimensions in millimetres. 
Fig. 1 DIMENSIONS FOR ANVIL 

3. Material —The anvil shall be made from brass strips conforming to IS : 410-1977 'Cold rolled brass 
sheet, strip and foil ( third revision )' and shall be hardened to 140 HV.

IS 8 10994 (PartS) -1985 

4. Other Requirements — The requirements not covered in this standard shall be as given in 
IS : 10994 ( Part i )-1984 'Specification for cartridges for shot guns : Part i General requirements'. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Anvil acts as initiator for firing the cartridge. 

This Indian Standard ( iS : i0994) is being issued in the following parts, Part i covering 
general requirements for shot gun cartridges and subsequent parts covering the individual components. 



Part 1 


General requirements 


Part 2 


Blank cartridges 


Part 3 


Case empty 


Part 4 


Cap filled 


Parts 


Anvil 


Part 6 


Propellent 


Part 7 


Discs 


Parts 


Air cushion 



Pune. 



Part 9 Lead shots
